An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain''' served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as the [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bentro]] six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Skirmish on Shelkonwa|blockade]] of [[Shelkonwa]].
